t: 拜占庭将领以撒克·科姆内诺斯被宣布为拜占庭皇帝,反对皇帝迈克尔六世·布林拉斯的统治.
te: The Byzantine general Isaac Komnenos is proclaimed Byzantine Emperor in opposition to reigning emperor Michael VI Bring…
dz: 拜占庭将领以撒克·科姆内诺斯被宣布为拜占庭皇帝,反对皇帝迈克尔六世·布林拉斯的统治.
de: The Byzantine general Isaac Komnenos is proclaimed Byzantine Emperor in opposition to reigning emperor Michael VI Bringas.

t: 洛林的弗雷德里克被选为教宗斯蒂芬九世.
te: Frederick of Lorraine elected as Pope Stephen IX.
dz: 洛林的弗雷德里克被选为教宗斯蒂芬九世.
de: Frederick of Lorraine elected as Pope Stephen IX.

t: 苏格兰国王麦克白被马埃尔·科卢伊姆·马克·多南沙达(英语:Máel Coluim mac Do…
te: King Macbeth of Scotland is killed at the Battle of Lumphanan by the forces of Máel Coluim mac Donnchada.
dz: 苏格兰国王麦克白被马埃尔·科卢伊姆·马克·多南沙达(英语:Máel Coluim mac Donnchada)的部队所杀.
de: King Macbeth of Scotland is killed at the Battle of Lumphanan by the forces of Máel Coluim mac Donnchada.

t: 艾萨克一世·科姆内诺斯手下的一支军队在哈迪斯之战中击败了忠于对手皇帝迈克尔六世·布林拉斯的军队.
te: An army under Isaac I Komnenos defeat forces loyal to rival emperor Michael VI Bringas in the battle of Hades.
dz: 艾萨克一世·科姆内诺斯手下的一支军队在哈迪斯之战中击败了忠于对手皇帝迈克尔六世·布林拉斯的军队.
de: An army under Isaac I Komnenos defeat forces loyal to rival emperor Michael VI Bringas in the battle of Hades.

t: 年长的拜占庭皇帝迈克尔六世·布列纳斯在位仅一年后退位.
te: Elderly Byzantine Emperor Michael VI Bringas abdicates after just one year on the throne.
dz: 年长的拜占庭皇帝迈克尔六世·布列纳斯在位仅一年后退位.
de: Elderly Byzantine Emperor Michael VI Bringas abdicates after just one year on the throne.

t: 拜占庭将领伊萨克·科姆内诺斯被皇帝加冕为拜占庭皇帝,在哈吉亚索菲亚(英语:Hagia Soph…
te: Byzantine general Isaak Komnenos is crowned Byzantine Emperor by patriarch Cerularius at the Hagia Sophia.
dz: 拜占庭将领伊萨克·科姆内诺斯被皇帝加冕为拜占庭皇帝,在哈吉亚索菲亚(英语:Hagia Sophia)被保皇党人塞卢里乌斯所封.
de: Byzantine general Isaak Komnenos is crowned Byzantine Emperor by patriarch Cerularius at the Hagia Sophia.
